summary: Both directions: conjugating by a matrix that is block upper triangular for the levels keeps block unitriangular matrices block unitriangular.

steps.claim: B and B⁻¹ are block diagonal for the levels (identity on the e_a and e*_a, mixing only the middle block of level ϱ), hence block upper triangular; by conj_mem_unitriangular, conjugation by B⁻¹ maps 𝖴 of the lattice form back to 𝖴 of the standard form and conjugation by B maps 𝖴 into 𝖴 of the lattice form. This gives both implications.
steps.lean:
lemma toLatBasis_mem_besselU : S.toLatBasis x ∈ besselU ↔ x ∈ besselU := ⟨(by
  simpa using! conj_mem_unitriangular (d := S.latBasis⁻¹) (by aesop) ·.out),
  (conj_mem_unitriangular (by aesop) ·.out)⟩
